remarks: Experience elevated living in this rare one-bedroom penthouse in the heart of downtown Stamford. Thoughtfully refreshed, the residence has been freshly painted and updated with new crown molding and wide plank flooring, creating a polished, timeless aesthetic throughout. The open living area is designed for both comfort and entertaining, extending seamlessly to an oversized private balcony with expansive city views. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances and a functional layout that integrates effortlessly with the living space. The bedroom is generously sized with ample closet storage and in-unit laundry adds everyday convenience. Residents enjoy a curated collection of recently refreshed amenities, including a modern lounge and work space, updated fitness center, on-site dog park, heated indoor pool and a rooftop terrace offering a private outdoor escape above the city. The building also offers 24/7 concierge service, a reserved garage parking space and a dedicated bike storage area, enhancing both convenience and lifestyle. Located just steps from Stamford's dining, shopping, and nightlife and convenient access to I-95, this penthouse delivers a refined urban lifestyle defined by design, comfort, and location.
